description: Interactive ER diagram editor stored as Markdown
config.dialect: Target database dialect for DDL export.
config.language: Language of the ER diagram editor.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
config.mcp: Enable the MCP server for AI assistant integration
config.ddl.comments: Write column / table comments (logical name + comment) in DDL.
config.ddl.tableOptions: Write MySQL table options (ENGINE, DEFAULT CHARSET, COLLATE).
config.ddl.explicitNull: Write NULL on nullable columns (otherwise only NOT NULL is written).
config.ddl.quoteIdentifiers: Quote every identifier. When off, only names that need it are quoted.
config.ddl.outputFile: Default file for **Save DDL…**, relative to the diagram's folder. Variables: `${fileBasenameNoExtension}`, `${fileBasename}`, `${workspaceFolder}`.
config.ddl.testOutputFile: Default file for **Save DDL…** when showing the test DDL. Same variables as `#markdown-er.ddl.outputFile#`.
config.ddl.testDataOutputFile: Default file for **Save data…** when showing the test DDL. Same variables as `#markdown-er.ddl.outputFile#`.
config.ddl.dataOutputFile: Default file for **Save data…** (seed-data INSERTs only), relative to the diagram's folder. Same variables as `#markdown-er.ddl.outputFile#`.
command.migrateWorkspace: ER Diagram: Update File Format of All Files in Workspace
config.markdown.generateMermaid: Write a Mermaid `erDiagram` of the tables into the `.ermd` file on save, so it can be read without the extension. Off by default (it adds to every diff).
config.markdown.generateTableDocs: Write a Markdown table of each table's columns into the `.ermd` file on save. Off by default (it adds to every diff).
config.migration.prompt: Ask whether to update a diagram that uses an older file format when it is opened. Files are never updated without asking; you can also run **ER Diagram: Update File Format (Migrate)**.
config.migration.prompt.ask: Ask when an older file is opened
